Name: Simple Hoarder Chest
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[b][size=5]Simple Hoard Chest[/size][/b]
[size=3]A spacious, upgradeable chest with automatic category tabs, custom tabs, search and built-in crafting—all wrapped in a familiar Stardew-style interface with bright iridium-purple trim.[/size]
[heading]A home for your hoard[/heading]
Simple Hoard Chest adds a new [b]Hoarder Chest[/b] for farmers who like to keep everything.
Start with [b]120 regular storage slots[/b], then expand your chest with craftable upgrade kits. Find items through category tabs, search your collection, and craft directly from your backpack and stored ingredients.
[b]Main Chest shows everything stored in the chest[/b], including its specialised and custom compartments.
[heading]Features[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Expandable storage:[/b] Start with 120 regular slots and add 120 per upgrade, up to 9,960 regular slots.[/*]
[*][b]Specialised storage:[/b] Store up to 9,999 of each exactly matching item variant in specialised compartments. Different qualities and meaningful item properties stay separate.[/*]
[*][b]Automatic categories:[/b] Materials, Farming, Fishing, Foraging, Minerals & Finds, Artisan & Food, Equipment and Miscellaneous.[/*]
[*][b]Custom tabs:[/b] Create up to 24 custom tabs. Choose their names, colours and icons, including icons from loaded modded items.[/*]
[*][b]Editable tabs:[/b] Personalise built-in tabs too, and rearrange their order while keeping Main Chest first.[/*]
[*][b]Compact search:[/b] Search item names, categories and IDs. Optional description searching is available in Settings and starts disabled.[/*]
[*][b]Built-in crafting:[/b] Browse recipes you know, see available ingredients, craft once, choose a quantity or craft the maximum.[/*]
[*][b]Quick storage controls:[/b] Deposit Matching and Organize help keep your collection manageable.[/*]
[*][b]Remembered views:[/b] Reopen on your last tab and scroll position, with an option to disable this.[/*]
[*][b]Custom appearance:[/b] Rename your chest and recolour its wooden body using the vanilla colour palette. Its bright iridium-purple trim stays purple.[/*]
[*][b]Adaptive interface:[/b] Smooth scrolling, draggable scrollbars, controller navigation and layouts that accommodate expanded backpacks, including 84 slots.[/*]
[/list][heading]Getting started[/heading]
Robin sends an introduction letter on the first morning after the mod is added, including on existing saves.
After receiving her letter, visit the Carpenter’s Shop and buy the [b]Hoarder Chest recipe for 5,000g[/b]. This also teaches the upgrade-kit recipe.
Robin sells the recipes. You craft the chest and kits yourself.
[b]Hoarder Chest crafting cost:[/b]
[list]
[*]150 Wood[/*]
[*]5 Copper Bars[/*]
[*]5 Iron Bars[/*]
[*]5 Gold Bars[/*]
[/list][b]Hoard Chest Upgrade Kit – H crafting cost:[/b]
[list]
[*]150 Wood[/*]
[*]5 Copper Bars[/*]
[*]5 Iron Bars[/*]
[*]5 Gold Bars[/*]
[/list]Hold an H upgrade kit and interact with a placed Hoarder Chest. Confirm the upgrade to permanently add [b]120 regular storage slots[/b] without removing its contents.
Upgrade kits expand regular storage; specialised compartments retain their separate bulk-storage limits.
[heading]Using your chest[/heading]
Open it with the normal interaction button.
[list]
[*][b]Left-click:[/b] Transfer a stack.[/*]
[*][b]Right-click:[/b] Transfer one item.[/*]
[*][b]Mouse wheel:[/b] Scroll.[/*]
[*][b]Hammer icon:[/b] Switch between storage and crafting.[/*]
[*][b]Settings gear:[/b] Adjust chest options and body colour.[/*]
[*][b]Edit Tab:[/b] Change the selected tab’s name, colour and icon.[/*]
[*][b]Sidebar + button:[/b] Create a custom tab.[/*]
[/list]Controller users can navigate inventories, tabs, crafting and settings. Shoulder buttons switch tabs, A/X transfers stacks, and B goes back.
[heading]Settings[/heading]
Settings are available inside the chest. Generic Mod Config Menu is optional.
Automatic category storage, chest ingredients for crafting, lowest-quality-first crafting and last-view memory are enabled by default.
Description searching and Most Used Items First are disabled by default. Menu size defaults to 100% and can be adjusted from 25% to 150%.
[heading]Compatibility and languages[/heading]
Simple Hoard Chest adds its own chest and leaves ordinary chest capacities unchanged.
Category tabs recognise compatible modded items through their loaded categories and tags. Organizing, bulk transfers and crafting respect recognised item-lock and favourite protections.
Includes all twelve built-in game languages: English, French, German, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Italian, Russian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Turkish and Hungarian.
[heading]Installation[/heading]
Requires [b]Stardew Valley 1.6[/b] and [b]SMAPI 4.1.0 or newer[/b].
[list=1]
[*]Download and extract Simple Hoard Chest.[/*]
[*]Place the
[code]SimpleHoardChest[/code]folder inside your game’s
[code]Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][b]Optional:[/b] Install Generic Mod Config Menu for configuration through its menu.
Before uninstalling, move all items out of the Hoarder Chest’s regular, specialised and custom storage, and remove its chests and upgrade kits from your save.
